scientific_question: Does optimization of a fixed recurrent predictor or training an explicit latent state explain O3's failure to exploit informative public histories, compared to fully trained public-history controls?
seeds: SHA256 UTF-8 of 'o4-public-20261023-v1:'+role+':'+family+':'+index, first 8 bytes as unsigned big-endian Random seed
public_fields: Only ordered (o_t,a_t,o_(t+1)) tuples; learner may use past public actions/observations, never future observations, hidden states, source role, or family labels as features.

hypotheses.H_OPTIMIZATION: Same two-state tanh architecture under 16-epoch Adam outperforms its same-epoch SGD version on both causal families using identical train and SELECT data.
hypotheses.H_LATENT_STATE: Two-state action-conditioned HMM fitted with unsupervised EM exceeds fully trained public-history counts under the same episodes on both causal families.
hypotheses.H_NULL: NULL must not show spurious claimed improvement versus strongest public-history control.

RNN_TANH_ADAM_16E.optimizer: episode full BPTT Adam beta1=0.9 beta2=0.999 epsilon=1e-8

selection: For each model family select only on 16 O4_SELECT episodes. Never consult O4_DEV for optimizer or selected initialization.

evaluation.sign: matched comparator minus candidate, positive gain indicates improvement
evaluation.resource_policy: All arms share exact public training examples. Record total generator/train/selection/inference CPU, process RSS, serialized state bytes. Do not claim compute/memory-matched advantage unless costs are equal or lower (with separately preregistered tolerance).
evaluation.cross_os: equal public source SHA256 episode digests and mean NLL within 1e-6 across Linux/Windows

engineering_tests: frozen protocol exact blob and base SHA
role split and reserved role refusal
actual weight/EM parameter changes on public train only
control receipt correctness and no future/hidden inputs
DEV evaluation produces no state mutation
prior_to_protected_science: Original independent Wingless/Yggdrasil FSA custody and admission remain separate; source-only public O4 does not qualify scientific original or native architecture integration
